name: Dark eyeliner to make iris pop

lead: Dark eyeliner along the lash line is used to frame the eye so the iris color looks stronger.
The claim comes from makeup practice, and no research on this specific effect was found.

paras: A dark border is said to increase local contrast, making the iris seem lighter or more saturated.
General eyeliner cautions apply, such as irritation or infection from contaminated products; sources reviewed give no specific data.

lead: Dark eyeliner to make the iris pop is a makeup practice in which dark liner is applied along the lash line to increase contrast with the iris. Practitioners say it makes eye color look more vivid.

paras: The idea is that a dark frame around the eye heightens the apparent brightness of the iris. This is a practitioner claim; no published study of the effect was identified. Eyeliner itself has a long history, dating to ancient Egypt and Mesopotamia according to Wikipedia.[1]
